description: §8.10 × §14.8.9 (SECURITY, RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"): a loop whose keyed read targets a table with a protected column (`<db protect="secret">`) is NOT §8.10-hoisted, so each row passes the per-query §14.8.9 strip exactly as the `.nobatch()` form does: `secret AS s` → `{"id":7}`, `lower(secret) AS x` → `{}`, `.all()` → `[{"id":7}]`; an unprotected projection keeps its columns. Pre-fix (0e253650, S239 review P1) the hoisted pre-fetch bypassed the strip and the client received `{"id":7,"s":"S7"}` / `{"id":7,"x":"s7"}` (E-PROTECT-003 only matched the protected column by its bare NAME, so an alias or expression escaped it).
rationale: §14.8.9: a protected column never reaches the client. §8.10.3: the rewritten loop is observationally equivalent to the un-rewritten loop — the un-rewritten loop's rows are stripped. Fail closed: a read over a table with any protected column keeps its per-iteration query.
